fusions.name: Run It Down
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Strikes a target up to 8 tiles away for 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Quarry Mark
fusions.desc: Flicks the fork at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stalking Cover
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, and you move 10% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Tireless Pursuit
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
